items.q: Is the massage for men only?
items.a: Yes, all treatments on this site are for men only.
At two locations in Jerusalem - Ben Baba 1 and Chaim Brody 15 - as well as home visits depending on the service area and availability.

items.q: Is there a home visit option?
items.a: Yes, home visits in Jerusalem can be arranged, depending on the service area and availability.

items.q: How much does a treatment cost?
items.a: Prices range between 200-300 NIS depending on the treatment and duration. See the full price list on the pricing page.

items.q: How long does a treatment take?
items.a: Depends on the treatment - 30 minutes for face & neck, 45-60 minutes for Swedish or medical, and 50 minutes for hot stone or cupping.

items.q: What's the difference between medical and Swedish massage?
items.a: Medical massage focuses on a specific issue like pain or chronic tension, while Swedish massage focuses more on overall relaxation.

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: The easiest way is to message on WhatsApp, or book directly through the booking system on the site.
Yes, treatment types can be combined depending on your needs - it's best to mention this in advance when booking.

about.title: About the Therapist
about.name: Israel Matusov
bio: Nice to meet you! I'm Israel Matusov, a certified massage therapist.

My vision is to help people with pain, stress, or tension, and treat them through touch. I believe massage is a wonderful tool that can help ease many issues such as chronic pain, mental stress, muscle tightness, and movement difficulties.
I believe in providing treatment that is personally tailored to each person according to the need that brought them in.

So whether you're experiencing muscle pain or simply want to release stress and disconnect from daily pressures - you've come to the right place. My goal is to give you a calming and grounding experience that helps you release tension and reconnect with your body.
